payload.description:
The scoring API Gateway listener is currently HTTP on port 80 with no hostname. Any non-local exposure needs TLS termination and hostname routing at the Gateway.

Add chart support for an HTTPS listener: certificateRef to a TLS Secret, hostname on listener and HTTPRoute, and values to choose HTTP (local) vs HTTPS (exposed). Cert issuance (e.g. cert-manager) stays a platform concern; the chart consumes a referenced Secret.

```gherkin
Feature: TLS on the scoring API Gateway
  Scenario: HTTPS listener with certificate reference
    Given scoringApi.gateway TLS is enabled with a certificate Secret and hostname
    When the chart renders
    Then the Gateway has an HTTPS listener on the configured port with that certificateRef and hostname
    And the HTTPRoute matches the configured hostname

  Scenario: Local HTTP mode still works
    Given TLS is not enabled
    When the chart renders
    Then the Gateway exposes the HTTP listener as today
```

Validate with render-based template tests in tests/docker/test_helm_scoring_api_templates.py.
payload.title: Gateway listener supports TLS and hostname for exposed scoring API
